saw_lines: Brand owners buy labels once per new garment run, then reorder the same name and size when production repeats.
So the sale is won on price per label and minimum order, which buyers compare before they read anything else.
Your site claims more than 350,000 customers, so test that number as the opening line of your next Google text ad batch against the current copy.
